subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We hope you are enjoying your recent purchase from our online store. We wanted to inform you that there has been a slight delay in the processing of your order due to high demand. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to get your order shipped out as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs.
